name: Lecture
description: For recorded classes and lectures: key concepts, examples, homework, and exam signals.

sections.title: Course / Topic
sections.instruction: State the course name and the specific topic this lecture covered, in one line. Only use what is stated in the source material; if the course name is never mentioned, give just the topic

sections.title: Key Concepts
sections.instruction: List each major concept introduced, as '**term** — definition'. Define terms only as the lecturer or materials defined them, not from general knowledge. Mark any definition that was unclear or incomplete in the source with '(unclear in lecture)' rather than filling it in yourself

sections.title: Worked Examples
sections.instruction: Summarize each example or problem worked through, with enough detail to recognize it when reviewing. If no examples were worked, write 'None in this lecture'

sections.title: What the Lecturer Emphasized
sections.instruction: List points the lecturer explicitly stressed, repeated, or called important. Only include emphasis that is evident in the transcript — do not infer importance

sections.title: Homework & Assignments
sections.instruction: List each assignment mentioned, with its due date ONLY if a date was explicitly stated. Never guess or invent a due date — if none was given, write 'no date mentioned'. If no assignments were mentioned, write 'None mentioned'

sections.title: Likely Exam-Relevant
sections.instruction: List anything explicitly flagged as exam material ('this will be on the test', 'know this for the midterm'). Only include explicit statements; if there were none, write 'Nothing explicitly flagged'

sections.title: Follow-up Reading
sections.instruction: List readings, chapters, or resources the lecturer or materials pointed to. If none, write 'None mentioned'
